label: SearXNG search
description: Self-hosted metasearch via SearXNG JSON API — broader link discovery than snippet-only APIs; best before crawl4ai/fetch for deep research

description_i18n.en: Self-hosted metasearch via SearXNG JSON API — broader link discovery than snippet-only APIs; best before crawl4ai/fetch for deep research
description_i18n.zh_CN: 通过自建 SearXNG JSON API 做元搜索，比仅返回短摘要的搜索 API 更能发现候选链接；深度调研时建议再接 crawl4ai/fetch
description_i18n.zh_HK: 透過自建 SearXNG JSON API 做元搜尋，比僅返回短摘要的搜尋 API 更能發現候選連結；深度調研時建議再接 crawl4ai/fetch

propose_guide: BEST WHEN: Owner has a SearXNG instance with JSON enabled; NL wants more / privacy-preserving / multi-engine web links; or tavily/web-search snippets are too thin. Prefer over tavily/web-search for self-hosted metasearch and larger candidate URL lists. Set language (e.g. zh-CN, zh-HK, en) from NL locale. NEXT: pick top URLs → crawl4ai/fetch for full markdown; use browserless/browse only if pages need a real browser. Do NOT use for stock quotes (yahoo/market-quotes) or FRED series (fred/series). NOT for posting or mutating sites.

propose_guide_i18n.en: BEST WHEN: Owner has a SearXNG instance with JSON enabled; NL wants more / privacy-preserving / multi-engine web links; or tavily/web-search snippets are too thin. Prefer over tavily/web-search for self-hosted metasearch and larger candidate URL lists. Set language (e.g. zh-CN, zh-HK, en) from NL locale. NEXT: pick top URLs → crawl4ai/fetch for full markdown; use browserless/browse only if pages need a real browser. Do NOT use for stock quotes (yahoo/market-quotes) or FRED series (fred/series). NOT for posting or mutating sites.
propose_guide_i18n.zh_CN: 最佳场景：Owner 已自建并开启 JSON 的 SearXNG；需要更多/更隐私/多引擎候选链接；或 tavily/web-search 摘要过短。自托管元搜索优先于 Tavily。按用户语言设置 language（如 zh-CN、zh-HK、en）。下一步：挑 Top URL → crawl4ai/fetch 抽正文；仅当强 JS/难抓时再用 browserless/browse。股价用 yahoo/market-quotes，宏观序列用 fred/series。不用于发帖或写外联。
propose_guide_i18n.zh_HK: 最佳場景：Owner 已自建並開啟 JSON 的 SearXNG；需要更多/更私隱/多引擎候選連結；或 tavily/web-search 摘要過短。自託管元搜尋優先於 Tavily。按用戶語言設定 language（如 zh-CN、zh-HK、en）。下一步：挑 Top URL → crawl4ai/fetch 抽正文；僅當強 JS/難抓時再用 browserless/browse。股價用 yahoo/market-quotes，宏觀序列用 fred/series。不用於發帖或寫外聯。
